terra.problem: It guesses why Jesus told the story and asserts how everyone in an unspecified room reacted. The text gives neither detail.
Papa comments on how he is telling the story when he says they will not joke around with it.
Saying the servant had barely made it out the door adds timing and a door that the text does not give.
The text says the master ordered the servant and his family sold; it does not call the order slavery.
The text does not say the master was the only person who could act on what happened.
